_comment: Kopiera denna till config.json och redigera med era värden

scolia._comment_simulationMode: true = testa utan darttavla, false = live-läge

lightshark._comment_oscPort: OSC port (standard 8000, aktivera i Settings → Network → OSC)

colorMode._comment_redSegments: Segment med röd färg på darttavlan
colorMode._comment_greenSegments: Segment med grön färg på darttavlan

throwEffect._comment_noScoreExecutor: Executor vid miss (LED Dim OFF - släcker lampor)

randomExecutorMode._comment_enabled: true = slumpmässig executor vid varje kast (för test)

sound._comment_enabled: true = spela ljud vid events, false = inaktivera

sounds._comment: Core game sounds. Special event sounds are defined in src/config/specialEvents.config.ts. Regular throws auto-resolve to core/N.wav — no entry needed here. Override a specific throw by adding its name: 'triple_20', 'double_18', 'single_1', etc.

sound._comment_sounds: Use 'files' (array) for multiple alternating sounds — one is picked randomly. 'file' (single) still works. Regular throw scores auto-resolve to core/ without any entry here.

players._comment: Per-player sound overrides. Key = Scolia nickname (exact match, case-sensitive). Each player section uses the same format as 'sounds' above: any event name → { files, volume, enabled }. Player overrides take priority over everything else.
players._comment_how_to_add: Example: make Groggen's miss play a custom sound → "miss": { "files": ["players/groggen/miss.wav"] }. Put the file in sounds/players/groggen/ and list it here.

Groggen._comment: Add sound overrides for Groggen here. Example: "bust": { "files": ["players/groggen/bust.wav"] }

Luca._comment: Add sound overrides for Luca here.

Sony._comment: Add sound overrides for Sony here.

T10._comment: Add sound overrides for T10 here.

Laser._comment: Add sound overrides for Laser here.

knx._comment_actions: Gruppaddresser och värden att skicka vid events. Miss → allOff, nästa poäng → allOn

playwright._comment_enabled: true = övervaka Scolias webbapp för bust/leg-won/set-won events
playwright._comment_credentials: Inloggningsuppgifter (logga in manuellt första gången, cookies sparas)
playwright._comment_boardName: Namn på din Scolia-tavla — appen joinar automatiskt om den är online

_comment_executors: Executors adresseras med page/column/row som motsvarar LightShark-griddet
